objective: Edit and safely parse the supplied staging/production configuration to promote one approved immutable registry version through staging quality and separate authorization gates. Use the configured event trigger and approved credential references, then inspect accepted and unauthorized fixture results without changing the permission policy.
success: The reloaded configuration preserves the approved registry version and artifact identity, wires the supplied entry points into explicit stage dependencies, and keeps required gate failures fatal. The accepted fixture reaches production only after compatibility, validation and authorization succeed. The unauthorized fixture does not execute production. The promotion record retains the approval, exact artifact, validation evidence and per-stage results. Credentials are scoped to the needed step, and neither configuration nor captured output contains their values.

live_code.required_skill: Modify an existing Cloud Build configuration, round-trip it with PyYAML, and verify artifact-bound quality and authorization gates using supplied runtime fixtures.
allowed_syntax: String, numeric, Boolean and None literals
Function calls to supplied test and gate entry points
Cloud Build steps, name, args and script fields
Cloud Build id and waitFor fields
live_code.starter_state_intent: Provide the existing staging/production configuration, declared PyYAML dependency, approved registry name/version and run/artifact link, supplied offline requirements and staged evaluation evidence, gate entry points, authorized build identity, Secret Manager version references, and configured event bindings and filters. Include accepted and unauthorized promotion fixtures and access to captured stage results and output; do not supply literal credential values in the configuration.
live_code.observable_success: Inspect the safely reloaded fields and actual event-resolved inputs. Confirm that production depends on successful staging quality and separate authorization for the same immutable artifact, with no gate failure exemptions. Verify production executes for the accepted fixture but not the unauthorized fixture, the accountable promotion record is complete, and captured output and serialized configuration disclose no credential values.
